CustomField.description: Selects the progress-indicator UI the formTemplate runtime renders across pages: vertical (left rail), base (horizontal dots), path (SLDS path), or the footer-docked footer base / footer path variants. Most styles require 3+ pages; vertical also adapts at narrow widths. Ignored when Hide Stage Indicator is true.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick how multi-page progress is shown: vertical rail, horizontal steps (base), a path bar (path), or footer-docked versions. Most styles appear once the form has three or more pages.
CustomField.label: Stage Indicator Type
